text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Phew... I definitely achieved adequate results. However—

text_block_list.name: Rushing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Hey, who's booked for the next coverage!?
What's the order of the interviews!?

text_block_list.name: Rushing Assistant
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, at another venue, the girl who was
considered a lock for Umamusume of the Year—

text_block_list.name: Rushing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
That Senior-class girl?!!
Then we need to pull out immediately! Pack up the gear and let's go!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...This is only the Junior Class, after all.
For all of us, the battle has only just begun.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What matters is what we do next.
And which race you'll claim victory in.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Still, lucky for you, Trainer. I'm a first-class Umamusume; I'll never lose my way on the path ahead."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Let's stay on track for the Triple Crown.

"The Triple Crown path... a stage you can only face once in a lifetime.
It is the route that leads to the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho."

Of course, this is a dream stage for many Umamusume as well,
and the struggle for it will be fierce in the extreme.
choice_data_list: If you're truly prepared for that...
If you are truly prepared for that...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even before coming to this academy,
I've always had both the talent and the determination.

And so, our next target was set for the Satsuki Sho,
the first leg of the Triple Crown route.
